scientific_integrity: The universal proof is symbolic. Finite exact checks are supplementary; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Uses the known nonequivariant bidirected-path homotopy sphere theorem; identifies PL fixed spaces and rank-one integral actions, but not integral homology or fundamental groups of geometric quotients. Novelty is best-knowledge relative to consulted literature; no independent verification is claimed.
title: Geometric fixed-point recursions for multipath spheres of bidirected linear graphs
